about: BV1 resource-variable admission. TestBindMappingProperty generates Go method sets and checks the binding against the interop table.

mutants.name: BV1 resource variables remain refused
mutants.rule: Resource-typed package variables are admitted as borrows.

mutants.name: BV1 ordinary host state admitted
mutants.rule: Non-resource, non-error variables remain refused.

mutants.name: BV1 any Close result makes a resource
mutants.rule: Close must return nothing or error alone.

mutants.name: BV1 package pointers silently promise non-nil
mutants.rule: A variable can be nil; map a resource pointer to Option[go.Ref[T]].

mutants.name: ffi-derive-reads-on-mutates
mutants.rule: A parameter Go says the function writes is never reads.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-reads-on-leak-to-result
mutants.rule: A parameter whose memory the result shares is never reads.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-any-verdict-is-reads

mutants.name: ffi-derive-wrong-parameter
mutants.rule: A fact names the binder of the Go parameter it is about, past a hidden context.Context.

mutants.name: ffi-derive-map-reads

mutants.to:

mutants.rule: A slice whose elements reach a map gets no reads fact: a write into the map is no mutation to Go's analysis.

mutants.name: exc1-bind-close-param
mutants.rule: ergo bind go writes implements Closer only for Close() or Close() error, never for a Close with a parameter.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-recv-own
mutants.rule: A Go method lends its receiver: ergo bind go writes own on a receiver only for the release and for a result that may hold the receiver.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-typeargs
mutants.rule: A generic result type may hold the receiver through its type arguments (iter.Seq[Value]), as the checker reads Seq[Value].

mutants.name: gbx2-bind-writes
mutants.from: if w, ok := v1.GoWrites[target]; ok && w.Reason != ""
mutants.to: if w, ok := v1.GoWrites[target]; false && ok && w.Reason != ""
mutants.rule: A Go function of v1.GoWrites binds with the slice it writes as its result.

mutants.name: gbx2-bind-marker
mutants.rule: The binding writes the ergo:writes line the checker and the lowering read.

mutants.name: gbx5-merge-struct
mutants.from: case len(differ) > 0 && mergeStruct(&first, platforms, byName, name):
mutants.to: case len(differ) > 0 && false && mergeStruct(&first, platforms, byName, name):
mutants.rule: A Go struct whose fields differ by platform binds the fields every platform declares alike (syscall.SysProcAttr), not refused whole.

mutants.name: gbx5-merge-alike
mutants.rule: A field whose Go declaration differs by platform, or that one platform lacks, is refused as platform-specific.

mutants.name: gbx5-startprocess-lent
mutants.rule: os.StartProcess lends its ProcAttr for the call (reviewed), so a borrow &attr is admitted.

mutants.name: gbx4-bind-own-methods
mutants.rule: The methods of time.Duration, Ergo's duration, bind as functions of their receiver (DurationString).

mutants.name: gbx3-bind-vars
mutants.rule: A Go package variable of v1.GoReadOnlyVars binds as a read-only let; every other non-error, non-resource variable stays refused.

mutants.name: gbx3-bind-any-var
mutants.rule: Only a reviewed variable binds: an unreviewed Go variable is host state Go may write.

mutants.name: gb2-bind-any
mutants.rule: Go's empty interface binds as go.Any.

mutants.name: gb2-bind-any-key
mutants.rule: A go.Any keys no Map: Ergo compares no go.Any.

mutants.name: gb1-bind-no-alias
mutants.rule: A method of a resource whose result may hold the receiver (the type, a pointer, an interface, a struct field) keeps its receiver.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-type-promises
mutants.rule: A (*S, error) result is go.Ref[S] only where the binder proves it non-nil (the rule before GOBIND-NIL: http.ProxyFromEnvironment's nil, nil).

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-nil-error
mutants.rule: An error variable is non-nil only under its if err != nil guard, or a package variable set once to a non-nil error; nil is no error.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-moved-sentinel
mutants.rule: A package error variable some function of its package assigns is no sentinel.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-error-call
mutants.rule: Only errors.New and fmt.Errorf calls are non-nil errors; another error function may return nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-call
mutants.from: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && p.w.proven[t]
mutants.rule: A delegated call proves the result only when its callee is proven.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-greatest-fixpoint
mutants.from: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && p.w.proven[t]
mutants.to: return fn != nil && fn.kind == k && (p.w.proven[t] || t == p.fn.target())
mutants.rule: The proof is a least fixed point: a function whose verdict reads itself proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-interface-type
mutants.rule: A conversion to, or a value of, a named interface type (type EI error) may be a nil error.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-var-as-const
mutants.rule: Only a constant is a non-nil error whatever happens; a variable may be set nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-any-error-func
mutants.rule: An error function's result is a non-nil error only when every return of it is.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-typed-any
mutants.rule: Only a value of a concrete type makes a non-nil error; one of an interface type may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-typed-off

mutants.rule: A nil *E in an error is a non-nil error (Go's typed nil); the rule proves it.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-pkg-pointer-set
mutants.from: return v != nil && !v.set && v.value != nil && pointerValue(v.value)
mutants.to: return v != nil && v.value != nil && pointerValue(v.value)
mutants.rule: A package pointer variable some function assigns may be nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-any-return
mutants.rule: Each return gives a non-nil pointer, a non-nil error, or a proven call's pair.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-or-guard
mutants.rule: Where a || b holds, only what a proves and what b proves after a failed both hold.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-guard-reassigned
mutants.rule: An assignment forgets what its variable was: err = nil under if err != nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-var-any-assign
mutants.rule: Only a non-nil value makes a variable non-nil.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-var-address
mutants.rule: A variable whose address is taken forgets at each call (keep(&s)).

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-unchecked-call
mutants.rule: x, err := g() pairs only a proven g's results.

mutants.name: gobind-nonnil-bare-return
mutants.rule: A bare return reads the named results where the flow stands.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-path-guard-late
mutants.rule: A call may clear a field: x.f's check holds until the next call.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-nil-guard
mutants.rule: x == nil proves x only where it fails.

mutants.name: gobind-prove-pair-broken
mutants.rule: A reassigned member breaks its pair.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-pair-implied
mutants.rule: A join keeps a pair only where each side holds it or knows one of its two non-nil.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-join
mutants.rule: Branches join by intersection.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-loop
mutants.rule: A loop's head joins what its body brings back.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-loop-break
mutants.rule: A break carries its state past the loop.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-nil-dead
mutants.rule: Only a nil check the facts contradict is dead.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-pair-refine
mutants.rule: x == nil proves the err of the pair (x, err), never x.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-deref
mutants.rule: x.f dereferences x: a nil x panics there, so x is non-nil after.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-deref-method
mutants.rule: A pointer method's value x.M takes a nil x.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-deref-or
mutants.to:
f.derefs(n.X, out)
				f.derefs(n.Y, out)
				return false
mutants.rule: The right operand of || or && may not run.

mutants.rule: A closure that assigns a variable may run where it is written.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-goto
mutants.rule: A goto's label knows nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-recover
mutants.rule: A deferred recover returns what the results hold at the panic: nil, nil.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-defer-result

mutants.rule: A deferred literal may set a named result only non-nil.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-defer-errnil
mutants.rule: A deferred literal may set err to anything only where err == nil holds.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-defer-blank
mutants.rule: A result named _ is no variable a deferred literal writes.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-escapes
mutants.rule: A literal the flow cannot see run makes what it assigns unknown.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-held

mutants.rule: A literal held by a variable called only directly is seen.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-stored
mutants.rule: A literal passed or stored escapes.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-go
mutants.rule: A literal started with go escapes.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-held-deferred
mutants.rule: go g() or defer g() runs g where the flow cannot see it.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-aliased
mutants.rule: A closure variable used other than by a direct call escapes.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-inner
mutants.rule: A literal inside an escaping literal escapes.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-call-inside
mutants.rule: A call of a closure variable inside an escaping literal is no seen call.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-result
mutants.rule: An escaping literal that assigns a named result may run after the return.

mutants.name: gobind-closure-fresh
mutants.rule: Each mention of an unknown variable is a variable of its own.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-once
mutants.rule: A range over a collection known non-empty leaves only after its body ran.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-any
mutants.rule: A range over a collection not known non-empty may not run.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-stale
mutants.rule: Assigning a collection forgets that it was non-empty.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-eq
mutants.rule: len(x) == 0 proves x non-empty where it fails.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-gt
mutants.rule: len(x) > 0 proves x non-empty; len(x) < 0 nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-flip
mutants.rule: 0 < len(x) is len(x) > 0.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-chan
mutants.rule: A channel's length may drop under another receiver.

mutants.name: gobind-loop-local-len
mutants.rule: A local named len is not the builtin.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-field-set
mutants.rule: x.f = v makes x.f non-nil until the next call or assignment.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-switch-open
mutants.rule: A switch with no default may match no case.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-scope
mutants.rule: Each declaration is its own variable: an inner s := hides the outer s.

mutants.name: gobind-flow-panic
mutants.rule: panic ends a path.

mutants.name: gobind-total-derived
mutants.rule: Derive writes the total facts.

mutants.name: gobind-total-div-var
mutants.rule: An integer division by a variable may divide by zero.

mutants.name: gobind-total-shift-signed
mutants.rule: A shift by a signed count panics on a negative one.

mutants.name: gobind-total-convert
mutants.rule: Only a numeric conversion or one between types of one basic type.

mutants.name: gobind-total-expr-other
mutants.rule: An index, a composite, a dereference, an assertion or a literal proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-total-stmt-other
mutants.from: return false // go, defer, select, send, goto, a type switch
mutants.rule: go, defer, select, send and goto prove nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-total-builtin
mutants.rule: panic and the allocating builtins prove nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-total-least
mutants.rule: A call is total only of a function proven total: the fixed point is the least, and another package's function is none.

mutants.name: gobind-total-global-write
mutants.rule: Only a local is written.

mutants.name: gobind-total-global-read
mutants.rule: Only a basic package variable is read.

mutants.name: gobind-total-func-value
mutants.from: return false // a function value, nil
mutants.rule: A function value proves nothing.

mutants.name: gobind-total-pointer-receiver
mutants.rule: A pointer receiver is refused.

mutants.name: gobind-total-range
mutants.rule: Only a range over an integer.

mutants.name: gobind-total-len
mutants.rule: len and cap only of a string or an array value.

mutants.name: ffi-host-row-not-written
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, host rows (HOST-ROW): ergo bind go writes a host row with needs Ambient.

mutants.name: valueresults-ignored
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority (HOST-ROW-3): os's Stat, Lstat and ReadDir are bound to runtime/v1/hostfs, whose results are values.

mutants.name: valueresults-spelled-in-hostfs
mutants.rule: A ValueResults declaration is written in os's binding, so hostfs's types are qualified by its import (hostfs.Info).

mutants.name: s2-bind-results-dropped
mutants.rule: interop.md Go writes in place (HOST-ROW-3 slice 2): ergo bind go returns the written slice first, before Go's own results.

mutants.name: s2fb-method-via-dropped
mutants.rule: interop.md (S2-FILE-B): (*os.File).Stat, ReadDir and Readdir bind as the methods whose targets are runtime/v1/hostfs's FileStat, FileReadDir and FileReaddir.
